title: Ing Courtly Pursuit
intro: keng pasilyo ning upaya, ing metung a pigura ning matas a katayuan meging infatuated ya keng metung a talasuyu na ing kayang kayapan aliwa ya keng yatu. Ing pamaglugud a ini meging sangkan ning serye da reng bage a magsubuk kareng katapatan, magpalwal kareng makasalikut a katutwan, at king katataulian magpatutu king panga-inosenti ning talasuyu.
clues: Menuknangan ku king sakup ning Ilug ning Nilo, king metung a palasyung ating maragul a impluwensya.
Metung a kayanakan a lalaki ing linub keng bale ku, at ing kayang presensya pepagulu ne ing yatu ku.
Sinubukan keng takpan, oneng menintun yang santungan king Ginu na.
ginabak ke ing imalan na ibat keng gulut, pero ing ebidensya tinuru ya keng pamaglinlang ku.
Ban mitahimik ing tsismis da ring marangal a babai, inagkat ku lang mitipun-tipun at dininan kung mataram a bage karing gamat da.
King katataulian, inamin ku king publiku ing kanakung kasalanan, at kilalanan ku ing katutuan king arapan ning ari.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
